implementation.targetScope: Tuple converter, property-name and raw-value helpers, and all 3.2.0 shorthands

caller.scope: Installed css-to-react-native 3.2.0 under styled-components 6.1.17. VentiMath uses the web StyleSheetManager iframe demo API; this converter serves the native entry, not browser style rendering.

changes: Independently written declaration grammars; runtime dependencies are exclusively VPM implementations.
Includes cyan/magenta, case-insensitive named colors and CSS comments; transform:none yields an empty transform list.
Rejects trailing tokens in background/font-weight, mixed none with decoration lines, and unclosed functions instead of discarding or accepting malformed input.
Own data-property writes avoid inherited setters; color membership excludes prototype names.
Restores hwb, lab, lch, gray and color function passthrough across color-bearing shorthands, with closed-function and trailing-token safeguards retained.
Exports transformRawValue through CommonJS, ESM and declarations, preserving raw whitespace and leaving invalid trailing-dot numeric strings unchanged.
